//! A probe crate whose public surface each shape changes in exactly one way.

/// A function a consumer calls.
pub fn removed(n: i32) -> i32 {
    n
}

/// A function whose signature one shape changes.
pub fn changed(n: i32) -> i32 {
    n
}

/// A trait a consumer implements.
pub trait Store {
    /// Reads the stored value.
    fn get(&self) -> i32;
}

/// A struct a consumer constructs.
pub struct Config {
    /// How long to wait.
    pub timeout: i32,
    /// What to call it.
    pub name: String,
}

mod private {
    /// Unreachable from outside the crate, whatever its signature.
    pub fn hidden() {}
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn works() {
        assert_eq!(super::removed(2), 2);
    }
}
